# MIGRATION CHECKLIST
# Sources      : 2 — ORACLE_SRC_CUSTOMERS, ORACLE_SRC_SALES
# Joins        : 1 — JOIN_CUST_SALES: Inner
# Branches     : 0 — No exception branches
# Computed cols: NET_AMOUNT, CUSTOMER_TIER, SALE_YEAR, SALE_MONTH, CUST_NAME_CLEAN, IS_BULK_ORDER
# Sinks        : 1 — BQ_TGT_SALES_SUMMARY
# Exceptions   : no

"""
PySpark Migration Script for IBM DataStage Job: JOB_CUSTOMER_SALES_ETL
Description: Customer Sales Daily ETL Job
Source DSX: JOB_CUSTOMER_SALES_ETL
"""

import os
import sys
import time
import json
import logging
import argparse
from typing import Dict, Any

from pyspark.sql import SparkSession, DataFrame
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.types import IntegerType, DoubleType, StringType, TimestampType

# Setup JSON logging
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format='%(message)s')
logger = logging.getLogger("JOB_CUSTOMER_SALES_ETL")


class JsonFormatter(logging.Formatter):
    def format(self, record):
        log_obj = {"timestamp": self.formatTime(record), "level": record.levelname}
        if isinstance(record.msg, dict):
            log_obj.update(record.msg)
        else:
            log_obj["message"] = str(record.msg)
        return json.dumps(log_obj)


handler = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout)
handler.setFormatter(JsonFormatter())
logger.handlers = [handler]

# CONFIG Dictionary
CONFIG = {
    "app_name": os.environ.get("APP_NAME", "JOB_CUSTOMER_SALES_ETL"),
    "source_db_url": os.environ.get("SOURCE_DB_URL", "jdbc:oracle:thin:@//localhost:1521/ORCL"),
    "source_db_user": os.environ.get("SOURCE_DB_USER", "etl_user"),
    "source_db_password": os.environ.get("SOURCE_DB_PASSWORD", "secret"),
    "target_db_url": os.environ.get("TARGET_DB_URL", ""),
    "quarantine_path": os.environ.get("QUARANTINE_PATH", "/tmp/quarantine"),
    "broadcast_threshold": int(os.environ.get("BROADCAST_THRESHOLD", "10000000")),
    "shuffle_partitions": int(os.environ.get("SHUFFLE_PARTITIONS", "200")),
    "enable_row_count_validation": os.environ.get("ENABLE_ROW_COUNT_VALIDATION", "false").lower() == "true",
    "bq_project": os.environ.get("BQ_PROJECT", "acme-analytics-prod"),
    "bq_dataset": os.environ.get("BQ_DATASET", "finance_reporting"),
}


def startup_validation():
    required_keys = ["source_db_url", "source_db_user", "source_db_password"]
    missing = [k for k in required_keys if not CONFIG.get(k)]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing required environment variables for CONFIG: {missing}")


def stage_ORACLE_SRC_CUSTOMERS(spark: SparkSession) -> DataFrame:
    """
    DataStage Stage: ORACLE_SRC_CUSTOMERS
    Type: PxOracleConnector
    Plugin: oracle
    """
    t0 = time.time()
    logger.info({"stage": "ORACLE_SRC_CUSTOMERS", "event": "entry"})
    sql_query = "SELECT CUST_ID, CUST_NAME, REGION, SEGMENT, CREATED_DATE FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE STATUS = 'ACTIVE'"
    df = spark.read \
        .format("jdbc") \
        .option("url", CONFIG["source_db_url"]) \
        .option("driver", "oracle.jdbc.driver.OracleDriver") \
        .option("user", CONFIG["source_db_user"]) \
        .option("password", CONFIG["source_db_password"]) \
        .option("query", sql_query) \
        .load()
    logger.info({"stage": "ORACLE_SRC_CUSTOMERS", "event": "exit", "duration_ms": round((time.time() - t0) * 1000)})
    return df


def stage_ORACLE_SRC_SALES(spark: SparkSession) -> DataFrame:
    """
    DataStage Stage: ORACLE_SRC_SALES
    Type: PxOracleConnector
    Plugin: oracle
    """
    t0 = time.time()
    logger.info({"stage": "ORACLE_SRC_SALES", "event": "entry"})
    sql_query = "SELECT SALE_ID, CUST_ID, PRODUCT_ID, SALE_DATE, AMOUNT, QUANTITY, DISCOUNT_PCT FROM SALES_FACT WHERE SALE_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE - 1)"
    df = spark.read \
        .format("jdbc") \
        .option("url", CONFIG["source_db_url"]) \
        .option("driver", "oracle.jdbc.driver.OracleDriver") \
        .option("user", CONFIG["source_db_user"]) \
        .option("password", CONFIG["source_db_password"]) \
        .option("query", sql_query) \
        .load()
    logger.info({"stage": "ORACLE_SRC_SALES", "event": "exit", "duration_ms": round((time.time() - t0) * 1000)})
    return df


def stage_JOIN_CUST_SALES(df_customers: DataFrame, df_sales: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
    """
    DataStage Stage: JOIN_CUST_SALES
    Type: PxJoin
    Inner Join on CUST_ID with Broadcast Optimization on Customers
    """
    t0 = time.time()
    logger.info({"stage": "JOIN_CUST_SALES", "event": "entry"})
    df_out = df_sales.join(F.broadcast(df_customers), on="CUST_ID", how="inner")
    logger.info({"stage": "JOIN_CUST_SALES", "event": "exit", "duration_ms": round((time.time() - t0) * 1000)})
    return df_out


def stage_TRANSFORM_SALES_METRICS(df_input: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
    """
    DataStage Stage: TRANSFORM_SALES_METRICS
    Type: PxTransformer
    Calculates Sales Metrics: NET_AMOUNT, CUSTOMER_TIER, SALE_YEAR, SALE_MONTH, CUST_NAME_CLEAN, IS_BULK_ORDER
    """
    t0 = time.time()
    logger.info({"stage": "TRANSFORM_SALES_METRICS", "event": "entry"})

    net_amount_expr = F.col("AMOUNT") * (F.lit(1) - F.col("DISCOUNT_PCT") / F.lit(100))
    tier_expr = F.when(net_amount_expr > 10000, "GOLD") \
                 .when(net_amount_expr > 5000, "SILVER") \
                 .otherwise("BRONZE")

    df_out = df_input \
        .withColumn("NET_AMOUNT", net_amount_expr) \
        .withColumn("CUSTOMER_TIER", tier_expr) \
        .withColumn("SALE_YEAR", F.year(F.col("SALE_DATE"))) \
        .withColumn("SALE_MONTH", F.month(F.col("SALE_DATE"))) \
        .withColumn("CUST_NAME_CLEAN", F.upper(F.trim(F.col("CUST_NAME")))) \
        .withColumn("IS_BULK_ORDER", F.when(F.col("QUANTITY") >= 100, 1).otherwise(0))

    logger.info({"stage": "TRANSFORM_SALES_METRICS", "event": "exit", "duration_ms": round((time.time() - t0) * 1000)})
    return df_out


def stage_FILTER_VALID_SALES(df_input: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
    """
    DataStage Stage: FILTER_VALID_SALES
    Type: PxFilter
    Filter: NET_AMOUNT > 0 AND CUST_ID IS NOT NULL AND SALE_DATE IS NOT NULL
    """
    t0 = time.time()
    logger.info({"stage": "FILTER_VALID_SALES", "event": "entry"})
    df_out = df_input.filter(
        (F.col("NET_AMOUNT") > 0) &
        (F.col("CUST_ID").isNotNull()) &
        (F.col("SALE_DATE").isNotNull())
    )
    logger.info({"stage": "FILTER_VALID_SALES", "event": "exit", "duration_ms": round((time.time() - t0) * 1000)})
    return df_out


def stage_AGG_DAILY_SUMMARY(df_input: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
    """
    DataStage Stage: AGG_DAILY_SUMMARY
    Type: PxAggregate
    Group By: REGION, SEGMENT, SALE_YEAR, SALE_MONTH
    Aggregations: SUM(NET_AMOUNT), COUNT(SALE_ID), AVG(NET_AMOUNT), MAX(NET_AMOUNT)
    """
    t0 = time.time()
    logger.info({"stage": "AGG_DAILY_SUMMARY", "event": "entry"})
    df_out = df_input.groupBy("REGION", "SEGMENT", "SALE_YEAR", "SALE_MONTH").agg(
        F.sum("NET_AMOUNT").alias("TOTAL_REVENUE"),
        F.count("SALE_ID").alias("TOTAL_ORDERS"),
        F.avg("NET_AMOUNT").alias("AVG_ORDER_VALUE"),
        F.max("NET_AMOUNT").alias("MAX_ORDER_VALUE")
    )
    logger.info({"stage": "AGG_DAILY_SUMMARY", "event": "exit", "duration_ms": round((time.time() - t0) * 1000)})
    return df_out


def stage_BQ_TGT_SALES_SUMMARY(df_input: DataFrame) -> None:
    """
    DataStage Stage: BQ_TGT_SALES_SUMMARY
    Type: PxBigQueryConnector
    Target Table: daily_sales_summary
    """
    t0 = time.time()
    logger.info({"stage": "BQ_TGT_SALES_SUMMARY", "event": "entry"})

    df_typed = df_input \
        .withColumn("TOTAL_REVENUE", F.col("TOTAL_REVENUE").cast(DoubleType())) \
        .withColumn("AVG_ORDER_VALUE", F.col("AVG_ORDER_VALUE").cast(DoubleType())) \
        .withColumn("MAX_ORDER_VALUE", F.col("MAX_ORDER_VALUE").cast(DoubleType()))

    table_id = f"{CONFIG['bq_project']}.{CONFIG['bq_dataset']}.daily_sales_summary"

    df_typed.write \
        .format("bigquery") \
        .option("table", table_id) \
        .option("writeMethod", "direct") \
        .mode("append") \
        .save()

    logger.info({"stage": "BQ_TGT_SALES_SUMMARY", "event": "exit", "duration_ms": round((time.time() - t0) * 1000)})


def main(run_mode: str = "full", dry_run: bool = False, log_level: str = "INFO"):
    startup_validation()

    spark = SparkSession.builder \
        .appName(CONFIG["app_name"]) \
        .config("spark.sql.shuffle.partitions", CONFIG["shuffle_partitions"]) \
        .config("spark.sql.adaptive.enabled", "true") \
        .config("spark.sql.adaptive.coalescePartitions.enabled", "true") \
        .getOrCreate()

    try:
        df_cust = stage_ORACLE_SRC_CUSTOMERS(spark)
        df_sales = stage_ORACLE_SRC_SALES(spark)

        df_joined = stage_JOIN_CUST_SALES(df_cust, df_sales)
        df_metrics = stage_TRANSFORM_SALES_METRICS(df_joined)
        df_filtered = stage_FILTER_VALID_SALES(df_metrics)
        df_summary = stage_AGG_DAILY_SUMMARY(df_filtered)

        if dry_run:
            logger.info("Dry run enabled — showing schema and sample output:")
            df_summary.printSchema()
            df_summary.show(10, truncate=False)
        else:
            stage_BQ_TGT_SALES_SUMMARY(df_summary)

    finally:
        spark.stop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="JOB_CUSTOMER_SALES_ETL PySpark Migration")
    parser.add_argument("--run-mode", choices=["full", "incremental", "rerun"], default="full")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--log-level", default="INFO")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    main(run_mode=args.run_mode, dry_run=args.dry_run, log_level=args.log_level)

import pytest
import datetime
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.types import (
    StructType, StructField, IntegerType, StringType, DoubleType, TimestampType
)

# Inline stage implementations for unit testing
def stage_JOIN_CUST_SALES(df_customers, df_sales):
    return df_sales.join(F.broadcast(df_customers), on="CUST_ID", how="inner")

def stage_TRANSFORM_SALES_METRICS(df_input):
    net_amount_expr = F.col("AMOUNT") * (F.lit(1) - F.col("DISCOUNT_PCT") / F.lit(100))
    tier_expr = F.when(net_amount_expr > 10000, "GOLD") \
                 .when(net_amount_expr > 5000, "SILVER") \
                 .otherwise("BRONZE")

    return df_input \
        .withColumn("NET_AMOUNT", net_amount_expr) \
        .withColumn("CUSTOMER_TIER", tier_expr) \
        .withColumn("SALE_YEAR", F.year(F.col("SALE_DATE"))) \
        .withColumn("SALE_MONTH", F.month(F.col("SALE_DATE"))) \
        .withColumn("CUST_NAME_CLEAN", F.upper(F.trim(F.col("CUST_NAME")))) \
        .withColumn("IS_BULK_ORDER", F.when(F.col("QUANTITY") >= 100, 1).otherwise(0))

def stage_FILTER_VALID_SALES(df_input):
    return df_input.filter(
        (F.col("NET_AMOUNT") > 0) &
        (F.col("CUST_ID").isNotNull()) &
        (F.col("SALE_DATE").isNotNull())
    )

def stage_AGG_DAILY_SUMMARY(df_input):
    return df_input.groupBy("REGION", "SEGMENT", "SALE_YEAR", "SALE_MONTH").agg(
        F.sum("NET_AMOUNT").alias("TOTAL_REVENUE"),
        F.count("SALE_ID").alias("TOTAL_ORDERS"),
        F.avg("NET_AMOUNT").alias("AVG_ORDER_VALUE"),
        F.max("NET_AMOUNT").alias("MAX_ORDER_VALUE")
    )


class TestJoinCustSales:
    """DataStage stage: JOIN_CUST_SALES | Inner Join test suite"""

    schema_customers = StructType([
        StructField("CUST_ID", IntegerType(), False),
        StructField("CUST_NAME", StringType(), True),
        StructField("REGION", StringType(), True),
        StructField("SEGMENT", StringType(), True),
    ])

    schema_sales = StructType([
        StructField("SALE_ID", IntegerType(), True),
        StructField("CUST_ID", IntegerType(), True),
        StructField("AMOUNT", DoubleType(), True),
    ])

    def test_JOIN_CUST_SALES_matched(self, spark, make_df):
        """DataStage stage: JOIN_CUST_SALES | Expression: Inner Join | Type: test_matched"""
        cust_data = [(101, "Acme Corp", "NORTH", "ENTERPRISE")]
        sales_data = [(1, 101, 1200.0)]

        df_cust = make_df(spark, cust_data, self.schema_customers)
        df_sales = make_df(spark, sales_data, self.schema_sales)

        res = stage_JOIN_CUST_SALES(df_cust, df_sales)
        assert res.count() == 1
        assert res.collect()[0]["CUST_NAME"] == "Acme Corp"

    def test_JOIN_CUST_SALES_unmatched(self, spark, make_df):
        """DataStage stage: JOIN_CUST_SALES | Expression: Inner Join | Type: test_unmatched"""
        cust_data = [(101, "Acme Corp", "NORTH", "ENTERPRISE")]
        sales_data = [(2, 999, 550.0)]

        df_cust = make_df(spark, cust_data, self.schema_customers)
        df_sales = make_df(spark, sales_data, self.schema_sales)

        res = stage_JOIN_CUST_SALES(df_cust, df_sales)
        assert res.count() == 0


class TestTransformSalesMetrics:
    """DataStage stage: TRANSFORM_SALES_METRICS | Transformer metrics test suite"""

    schema_input = StructType([
        StructField("CUST_NAME", StringType(), True),
        StructField("AMOUNT", DoubleType(), True),
        StructField("QUANTITY", IntegerType(), True),
        StructField("DISCOUNT_PCT", DoubleType(), True),
        StructField("SALE_DATE", TimestampType(), True),
